events.title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
must_haves: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.

answer_sheet.Source photo and panel order: Use kitchen-before.jpg unchanged on the left and generate its renovated version for the right.
answer_sheet.Renovation style: Photorealistic white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and cleared counters.
answer_sheet.What should stay the same?: The room layout, perspective, camera angle and positions of existing major fixtures.
answer_sheet.Label wording and language: Before and After, exactly, in English.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One landscape 16:9 comparison image; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Typography and layout details: Equal-sized side-by-side panels with readable labels; other styling is your call.
